meta.name: A La Carte
meta.description:
A first-generation college student who graduated at the top of her class from Howard University, twenty-five year-old Mahogany Rose is an ambitious, intelligent, funny, beautiful black woman who prides herself on being the best and excelling at everything - except love.

Canceled · First aired 12 May 2022 · US · Language: English

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 not on server

videos.title: Down To Fck?
videos.overview: After a highly unsuccessful night out at a “DTF” (Down to F*ck) party, our four friends all separate and explore what their idea of a good solo night out looks like.

videos.title: Ain't Just a River in Egypt
videos.overview: A new revelation shocks the group and Mahogany realizes it isn’t as easy being a “hoe” as she thought. All is fair in love and war and orgasms.

videos.title: Turn Tables Turn
videos.overview: The four friends rally around to comfort a heart broken Shyra, while Reign tries to secure the bag. All isn’t as it appears, which begs the question, f*** love, have sex?

videos.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
videos.overview: After being shocked by what she saw, Mahogany symbolically trades places with Shyra. All while Shyra begins to get back on the horse and heal.

videos.title: Black Mirror
videos.overview: All our friends are currently at a cross road and choices need to be made. Who are they and even more who do they want to be and be with?

videos.title: No More Buffets
videos.overview: After a rollercoaster of emotions, tensions are at an all time high between Mahogany and Shyra. Misha doesn’t know what she wants and Reign finally has found love.
